svg.text: Every box is a file in the repo — the appliance, the gateway it trusts, and the cloud it thinks with.
Signed releases only: a bad signature is refused,
and a failed update rolls itself back.
A box never holds the key. It carries a capped, revocable
device token; the gateway meters every call.
agent.ps1 — one file on the PC
Line details are entered on the box's own screen;
the PBX is generated on the box. Fails open, always.
listener.py — the resident speaks; audio goes to the cloud
Voice-Board Driver [ui.py] — opens the views the router picks
vision judge — open weights, served by Ollama
text judge fallback — open weights, on the box
Open weights running in the app itself.
The first look at a screen and the reflexes
Clicks are aimed at named controls, never pixels.
A screenshot is taken only to judge, never to aim.
server.js — the hub every surface feeds
FUSE BOX, POWERED BY MUSE SPARK
